This prevents workflow execution failure and preserves delivery capability while still recording the configuration issue. This represents a substantive, bounded reliability improvement.

observations.behavior: Adds a warning log and fallback to integration's own sender instead of throwing an error when an invalid or off-domain email address is supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: In PostHog's workflow execution, an email step may carry a placeholder or invalid address. Previously, this would fail the entire send. Now, the system warns and uses the integration's verified address, preserving delivery while recording the issue.

observations.behavior: Adds a warning log and fallback to integration's own sender instead of throwing an error when the supplied email is not on the verified domain.
observations.posthog_connection: In PostHog's workflow execution, an email step may carry an address not owned by the selected sender. Previously, this would fail the entire send. Now, the system warns and uses the integration's verified address, preserving delivery while recording the issue.
